text:
Pontus Holmberg, a sixth-round pick by Toronto in 2018, has become a useful piece in Tampa. He has 11 points in 16 games, including a four-point career night against Winnipeg that had NHL.com writing about a fit alongside Anthony Cirelli and Brandon Hagel. He's never scored at this pace before.

How much will last? His finishing is right on his chances, so it isn't hot shooting. The points rate, 2.85 per 60, is well above his talent range (1.47 to 2.24), and his 5v5 impact relative to teammates is negative (6 points), so expect some cooling.

What's real is the defense. Evolving-Hockey had him in the 99th percentile at taking chances away last season, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking flagged him as a setup man (91st percentile in primary shot assists) whose offense comes off the rush. Our range has him around 40 points. That's a good season for a player who plays 14 minutes.
headline: Holmberg is doing more than anyone expected
